name: Franka Hand
src: Franka figures from memory (0.73 kg, 80 mm, 70 N continuous), unverified; payload and price assumed
notes: mass_kg is the figure the Payload check charges against the arm; the composed model uses the simulator model's own mass. force_n is the range of grip force it can hold. hold says how it carries an object. The tool point is tool_offset_m out from the arm's flange along its z axis. It runs from the Franka controller, so it is listed for the fr3 only.
